i.norm: Parses a command line that supplies the short option "-s", which belongs to an option group registered with the {@link Options}. The remaining (null) arguments are tolerated because stopAtNonOption is set to true. Parsing should succeed and return a non-null {@link CommandLine}.
Define a single short option "-s" and register it via an option group.
The first argument selects "-s"; the remaining nulls are non-options.
